title: These MacBook refurbs are only $650
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get a refurbished M2 MacBook Air with 8GB of memory and a 256GB SSD for $649.99 (reg. $999).

New MacBooks are expensive, but if you’re just looking for a good machine for work or school, you might not need to pay full price. Refurbished Macs are a great option if you want a reliable computer for a solid price. That’s how you can get this 2022 MacBook Air for just $649.99 (reg. $999).

This MacBook Air has an M2 chip with an 8-core CPU and an 8-core GPU. That’s enough for web browsing, documents, video calls, and photo editing. For video work, a built-in media engine speeds up editing and exporting in H.264, HEVC, and ProRes. With 8GB of unified memory, switching between apps is quick. Storage is a 256GB SSD, enough for your apps, documents, and photos.

The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display has a resolution of 2560 by 1664 and reaches 500 nits, with True Tone and P3 wide color. You can also connect one external display at up to 6K. Other features include Touch ID, a backlit Magic Keyboard, a 1080p FaceTime HD camera, and four speakers with Spatial Audio.

Battery life reaches up to 18 hours of movie playback. At 2.7 pounds, this MacBook Air is easy to carry, and you can charge it through MagSafe 3 or either Thunderbolt/USB 4 port.

This model has a Grade B refurbished rating, meaning it may have light scuffing on the case or light scratches and dents on the body, but it still works great, and you can pick it up on sale.

Get a refurbished MacBook Air while they’re only $649.99.
